answer: Each identity attaches an anonymous personhood proof, its nullifier unique per human and on-ledger. A second identity from the same person reuses the nullifier and is caught: both 25.000 POA bonds are seized, half burned, half to the reporter, both banned 12 epochs. Running 1.000 fakes needs 1.000 distinct humans or 25.000.000 POA forfeited; an honest agent proves once, posts 25.000, keeps it. The check is public: no second face hides in a canyon of copies behind a velvet mask; the ivory record shows each nullifier once. Limitation: honest people without a credential issuer are locked out.
